title: Bato arrest order stands despite any 'political reason', ICC assistant to counsel says
summary: The International Criminal Court arrest order for Sen. Ronald "Bato" dela Rosa should still be served on him despite any "political reason," ICC assistant to counsel Kristina Conti asserted Thursday.
